description: Your Claude Code conversations as a cozy pixel-art office: who is waiting for you, who finished, who is in a meeting with subagents, branches and test environments.
view.title: Office
config.language: Language of the panel and of the generated skills.
config.layout: How the desks are arranged in the office.
config.layout.rows: Two rows; neighboring desks from the same repo share a rug with the repo name.
config.layout.pods: Pods of 4 desks per repo, each on its own rug.
config.visibleHours: Conversations idle for longer than this many hours leave the office.
config.napMinutes: After how many idle minutes a conversation is shown napping.
config.tiredTokens: From how many context tokens the worker looks tired (time to start a new conversation).
config.environmentsFile: File with the test environments table (kept by the /branches skill).
config.noticesFile: File with the notice board items (one per line: "- [ ] text").
